versions.changelog:
- 新增主脚本 scripts/build_daily_report.py，统一三大数据源抓取、筛选与格式输出
- 技能升级为多源聚合：支持优设读报、36氪、虎嗅三大数据源
- 推送内容新增交替补充及优先级规则，每日最多推送15条
- 新闻格式支持 Markdown 可点击链接，优化微信等平台的跳转体验
- 输出分为“优设读报”与“科技资讯精选”，来源清晰，统计条数

- Initial release of 设计日报 (design-daily-news) skill.
- Automatically fetches daily updates from multiple design, AI, and product-related websites.
- Aggregates and filters content to focus on AI, hardware, product design, and technology trends.
- Supports customizable time ranges (24h / 48h / 7d) for flexible information retrieval.
- Outputs curated news in a clean, standardized format for easy reading and reuse.
- Limits daily output (up to 15 items), prioritizing the most relevant and high-quality industry updates.
